protocol.title: ZR Plasmid Miniprep-Classic plasmid DNA purification (Zymo D4015/D4016/D4054)
protocol.summary: Silica spin-column miniprep of plasmid DNA from E. coli via modified alkaline lysis (P1/P2/P3 color-coded buffers) and Zymo-Spin IIN columns. Transcribed from the Zymo instruction manual v1.0.4. All steps are performed at room temperature (15-30 C) and all centrifugation is at 11,000-16,000 x g unless noted. Review pending: confirm kit size and cross-check against your lab's validated SOP before use.

source.userInstruction: Import this PDF into LabRecord as a review draft: structure into steps and materials, attach source references, and flag anything unconfirmed in needsReview instead of guessing.

steps.instruction: One-time buffer preparation (before first use): add 95% ethanol to the concentrated Plasmid Wash Buffer at a 4:1 ethanol:buffer volume ratio. D4015: add 96 ml 95% ethanol to 24 ml Plasmid Wash Buffer. D4016: add 192 ml 95% ethanol to 48 ml. D4054: add 192 ml 95% ethanol to EACH 48 ml bottle. Mark the bottle once ethanol has been added.
needsReview: Skip this step if ethanol has already been added to the Plasmid Wash Buffer (check the bottle label).
Ethanol volume differs by kit; confirm which kit you have (see protocol-level review flag).

steps.instruction: Centrifuge 0.5-5 ml of bacterial culture in a clear 1.5 ml tube at full speed for 15-20 s in a microcentrifuge. Discard the supernatant. For larger culture volumes, repeat this step in the same tube as needed.
needsReview: Choose the culture volume (0.5-5 ml) for your plasmid copy number / yield needs.
Step 1 says 'full speed'; the manual's general note specifies all spins at 11,000-16,000 x g. Confirm your rotor's full speed is compatible.

steps.instruction: Add 200 ul P1 Buffer (Red) to the tube and resuspend the pellet completely (by vortexing or pipetting).

Add 200 ul P2 Buffer (Green) and mix by inverting the tube 2-4 times. Lysis is complete when the solution is clear, purple, and viscous. Proceed to the next step within 1-2 min; do not over-lyse. When processing many samples, work in groups of <=10. Caution: P2 contains NaOH - wear gloves and eye protection.

Add 400 ul P3 Buffer (Yellow) and mix gently but thoroughly - do NOT vortex. The sample turns yellow when neutralization is complete; a green K-SDS/cell-debris precipitate forms. Incubate at room temperature for 1-2 min. Caution: P3 contains chaotropic reagents - handle with care.
Centrifuge the sample(s) for 2 min (11,000-16,000 x g).

Place a Zymo-Spin IIN column in a Collection Tube and transfer the supernatant from the previous step into the column. Pipette carefully to avoid disturbing the green pellet / transferring cellular debris.
Centrifuge the Zymo-Spin IIN column / Collection Tube assembly for 30 s (11,000-16,000 x g).

Discard the flow-through from the Collection Tube (do not let the flow-through touch the bottom of the column) and return the column to the Collection Tube. The column+tube capacity is ~800 ul; empty the tube whenever necessary to prevent contaminating the column with flow-through.
Add 200 ul Endo-Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge for 30 s (11,000-16,000 x g).
Add 400 ul Plasmid Wash Buffer (with ethanol already added) to the column and centrifuge for 1 min (11,000-16,000 x g).
needsReview: Confirm ethanol was added to the Plasmid Wash Buffer before use (see the buffer-preparation step).

steps.instruction: Transfer the column into a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube. Add 30 ul DNA Elution Buffer directly to the center of the column matrix and centrifuge for 30 s to elute the plasmid DNA. DNA Elution Buffer is 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.5, 0.1 mM EDTA; nuclease-free water may be substituted if required.
needsReview: For large plasmids (>10 kb), the manual (p.5) recommends incubating the column 5-10 min, pre-warming DNA Elution Buffer to 50 C, and increasing elution volume to >=50 ul. Apply only if your plasmid is large.
